name: Trainerize
summary: Personal training and fitness-coaching platform. Deliver workout and nutrition plans, message clients and take payments from one branded app, so trainers can coach more clients online.
best_for: personal trainers and studios delivering structured workout/nutrition coaching through a polished client app, scaling by client count
skip_if: you coach a handful of clients over WhatsApp and sheets happily, or you want one flat price without add-on shopping
honest_knock: The client-count ladder looks gentle, but most add-ons are flat and they land hardest on the smallest coach: at five seats a $23 Pro plan dressed with nutrition, payments and video is $63, while the same three turn the $225 two-hundred-client row into $290. Price the stack you'll actually coach with, and note that the branded app is $169 to Trainerize plus a $99/year Apple Developer Account billed by Apple. That said, the client experience and ABC ecosystem are genuinely mature; churn-prone coaches lose more to a clunky app than to a fair subscription.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-27 on www.trainerize.com/pricing in the browser pane, both billing toggles and every seat selector operated; prices in USD and subject to applicable taxes, annual plans billed once a year) Basic is free for 1 client. Grow is $9 a month billed annually or $10 month-to-month, for 2 clients. Pro is priced by client seats: 5, 15, 30, 50, 75, 100 and 200 seats cost $23, $45, $71, $122, $162, $203 and $225 a month billed annually, or $25, $50, $79, $135, $180, $225 and $250 month-to-month. Studio Plus is $248 a month per location billed annually ($275 monthly) for 500 client seats and $342 ($380) for 1,000; 5+ locations are quoted. Annual billing saves 10% and there are no long-term contracts. Add-ons on Grow and Pro: Advanced Nutrition Coaching $20 a month on Grow, Pro 5 and Pro 15 and $45 from Pro 30 to Pro 200; Business $25; Stripe Integrated Payments $10; Video Coaching $10; and on Pro a Custom Branded App at a one-time $169, which also needs your own $99-a-year Apple Developer Account, charged by Apple. Studio Plus includes all of them. FitMetrics is a separate add-on from $6 per client. A 30-day trial with unlimited clients needs no card; add-ons are not included in it.
